_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: the attractor — force toward a point

voltage.why: force as the invisible made felt — the field is fully real before any arrow reveals it; iron filings only expose a power that was always there.
mass as a political negotiation — τ = w·d places the heavier body closer to the pivot; weight buys position, and balance is a settlement not a neutrality.

voltage.after: the attractor — force toward a point
voltage.why: the attractor as desire that seizes the subject — it overwrites your own velocity and spirals YOU inward; gravity-as-power, the pull that becomes coercion.
the many pulling the one, and the one never arriving — a strange attractor stays bounded yet never repeats; superposition that refuses to resolve into a single fate.
the wall as law — inside the cube one imposed vector replaces gravity itself; the border does not merely enclose, it rewrites the physics of who is caught within it.
